::: {#exr-fibonacci}
## How fast do the ratios converge?

1. Implement the function `fibonacci_ratios(n)`, which returns the vector of the ratios $q_1, \ldots, q_n$ from
   @exr-golden-ratio.

1. Compute the ratios for $n = 20$ together with their errors. By which factor does the error fall in each step?

::: {.lm-scaffold}
```{julia}
# function fibonacci_ratios(n)
#     ...
# end
```
:::

::: {.lm-solution}
The function is in `src/fibonacci.jl` (see the appendix).

```{julia}
φ = (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2
ratios = fibonacci_ratios(20)
[ratios abs.(ratios .- φ)]
```

The error falls by the factor $\varphi^2 \approx 2.6$ in each step, and its sign alternates: the ratios lie
alternately above and below $\varphi$.
:::
:::
